problem.observed: Studio can remain on Menyambungkan Studio and then show Koneksi data belum selesai even while Google PKCE and Supabase user verification return HTTP 200.
problem.rootCause: The onboarding gate can block membership loading behind redundant remote session verification, while the same-origin data gateway can wait too long before the direct Supabase fallback gets a chance to run.
problem.screenshots: real Android browser screenshots supplied by the user on 2026-08-01

productionEvidence.note: These logs prove the observed Google authentication path reached Supabase successfully; they do not replace post-deployment physical-device verification of the entire Studio UI flow.

validation.capacityNote: No 900-million-or-larger concurrent-login claim is made without distributed load testing and production capacity evidence.
